item.title: Foundation damaged due to pothole, 30th July
item.description:
Someone reported this pothole back in March, yet we are now approaching August and the Council has still done absolutely nothing to repair it. This is extremely disappointing and certainly gives residents reason to reconsider their support at the next local election. Since March, I have noticed that my house shakes significantly more every time buses drive through the pothole. I am becoming increasingly concerned that the continued deterioration of the road could eventually cause damage to nearby properties. Could someone please explain why no action has been taken despite the issue being reported several months ago? Are you waiting until the road collapses into a sinkhole or until properties are damaged before carrying out repairs?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 99, Halfway Street, Longlands, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
